acquisition method: The digest was analyzed using the data-dependent multitask capability of the instrument
alkylation reagent: The bands were then reduced with DTT and alkylated with iodoacetamide prior to the in-gel digestion.
cleavage agent: All bands were digested in gel by adding 5 μl of 10 ng/μl trypsin in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and incubating overnight at room temperature.
enrichment method: HA-tagged βIV-spectrin was expressed in COS-7 cells (American Type Culture Collection catalog no. CRL-1651, RRID: CVCL 0224) and purified using Anti-HA antibody (3724; Cell Signaling) loaded onto TrueBlot agarose beads (00-8800-25; Rockland).
fractionation method: The protein samples were fractionated on an SDS-PAGE and submitted for analysis, and a small area around the band was cut from the gel.
fragmentation method: The data were analyzed by using all collision-induced dissociation spectra collected in the experiment to search the Chlorocebus sabaeus reference sequence protein database
instrument: ThermoScientific Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer system
The LC–MS system was a Dionex Ultimate 3000 nano-flow HPLC interfacing with a ThermoScientific Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer system.
ionization type: The microelectrospray ion source is operated at 2.5 kV.
labeling: The chromatograms for these peptides were plotted based on known fragmentation patterns, and the peak areas of these chromatograms were used to determine the extent of phosphorylation.
reduction reagent: The bands were then reduced with DTT and alkylated with iodoacetamide prior to the in-gel digestion.
